tools.name: host_createOrder
tools.description: Place a delivery order on the user's account. This MOVES MONEY: it charges the user's card and appends a transaction.

hour.description: Order hour (0-23, Pacific). Demo default is late-night.

amount.description: Amount in integer cents, negative for a debit: divide by 100 exactly once before displaying.

balance.description: Balance in integer cents: divide by 100 exactly once before displaying.

spent.description: Spent this month, in integer cents.

outputSchema.description: The cashflow periods live under `data` — the array itself is `data`, never the response body.

data.description: One entry per period, oldest first.

in.description: Money in for the period, in integer cents (e.g. 1284000 = $12,840.00): divide by 100 exactly once before displaying, including any totals you compute.

out.description: Money out for the period, in integer cents: divide by 100 exactly once before displaying.

amount.description: Amount in integer cents, negative for a debit.

tools.name: host_getSpendingInsights
tools.description: Spending by category for the current period.

outputSchema.description: The spending slices live under `data` — the array itself is `data`, never the response body.

data.description: One slice per spending category, largest first.

amount.description: Amount spent in integer cents (e.g. 285000 = $2,850.00): divide by 100 exactly once before displaying, including any totals you compute.

tools.name: host_getTransaction
tools.description: Fetch one transaction by id, including its status timeline.

amount.description: Amount in integer cents, negative for a debit: divide by 100 exactly once before displaying.

tools.name: host_listAccounts
tools.description: List the user's bank accounts with balances.

balance.description: Balance in integer cents: divide by 100 exactly once before displaying.

tools.name: host_listAccountTransactions
tools.description: List recent transactions for one account.

data.description: One page of transactions. The rows are `data.data`; the outer `data` is the API envelope.

amount.description: Amount in integer cents, negative for a debit: divide by 100 exactly once before displaying.

tools.name: host_listCards
tools.description: List the user's physical and virtual cards.

tools.name: host_listCardTransactions
tools.description: List recent transactions charged to one card.

data.description: One page of transactions. The rows are `data.data`; the outer `data` is the API envelope.

amount.description: Amount in integer cents, negative for a debit: divide by 100 exactly once before displaying.

saved.description: Saved so far, in integer cents.

tools.name: host_listTransactions
tools.description: Search and list transactions across all accounts, with filters, sorting and cursor pagination.

category.description: Category, e.g. dining, groceries, coffee, transport, subscriptions

data.description: One page of transactions. The rows are `data.data`; the outer `data` is the API envelope.

amount.description: Amount in integer cents, negative for a debit: divide by 100 exactly once before displaying.

tools.name: host_transferMoney
tools.description: Send money to a person from the user's checking account. This IRREVERSIBLY MOVES MONEY: it debits checking and appends a transfer. There is no undo.

amount.description: Amount to send in cents (positive whole number), e.g. 50000 = $500.00

recipient_name.description: Who the money goes to, e.g. Alex Rivera

memo.description: Optional note shown on the transfer, e.g. June rent

amount.description: Amount in integer cents, negative for a debit: divide by 100 exactly once before displaying.
